crossrefs.text: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
Hallelujah! Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.

the sounds of joy and gladness, the voices of the bride and bridegroom, and the voices of those bringing thank offerings into the house of the LORD, saying: ‘Give thanks to the LORD of Hosts, for the LORD is good; His loving devotion endures forever.’ For I will restore the land from captivity as in former times, says the LORD.
“Give thanks to the LORD; call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.
Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
But from everlasting to everlasting the loving devotion of the LORD extends to those who fear Him, and His righteousness to their childrenʼs children—
Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good. His loving devotion endures forever.
So we say with confidence: “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?”
Blessed is the man who has made the LORD his trust, who has not turned to the proud, nor to those who lapse into falsehood.
What then shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
In God, whose word I praise— in God I trust. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
This is what the LORD says: “Cursed is the man who trusts in mankind, who makes mere flesh his strength and turns his heart from the LORD.
But blessed is the man who trusts in the LORD, whose confidence is in Him.
Trust in Him at all times, O people; pour out your hearts before Him. God is our refuge. Selah
Lowborn men are but a vapor; the exalted are but a lie. Weighed on the scale, they go up; together they are but a vapor.

notes.title: I will never leave you nor forsake you

crossrefs.text: Surely God is my salvation; I will trust and not be afraid. For the LORD GOD is my strength and my song, and He also has become my salvation.”
Guard me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked. Keep me safe from men of violence who scheme to make me stumble.
The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer. My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
Show me a sign of Your goodness, that my enemies may see and be ashamed; for You, O LORD, have helped me and comforted me.
Then the Amorites who lived in the hills came out against you and chased you like a swarm of bees. They routed you from Seir all the way to Hormah.
The LORD is my light and my salvation— whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life— whom shall I dread?
All day long they engulf me like water; they enclose me on every side.
The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation. He is my God, and I will praise Him, my fatherʼs God, and I will exalt Him.
When Jesus heard this, He said, “This sickness will not end in death. No, it is for the glory of God, so that the Son of God may be glorified through it.”
For there is no mention of You in death; who can praise You from Sheol?
O God, You have taught me from my youth, and to this day I proclaim Your marvelous deeds.
Even when I am old and gray, do not forsake me, O God, until I proclaim Your power to the next generation, Your might to all who are to come.
But as for me, it is good to draw near to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may proclaim all Your works.
O Lord, by such things men live, and in all of them my spirit finds life. You have restored me to health and have let me live.
The LORD will save me; we will play songs on stringed instruments all the days of our lives in the house of the LORD.
Are You not from everlasting, O LORD, my God, my Holy One? We will not die. O LORD, You have appointed them to execute judgment; O Rock, You have established them for correction.
Open the gates so a righteous nation may enter— one that remains faithful.
I love the LORD, for He has heard my voice— my appeal for mercy.
Blessed are those who wash their robes, so that they may have the right to the tree of life and may enter the city by its gates.
By its light the nations will walk, and into it the kings of the earth will bring their glory.
But nothing unclean will ever enter it, nor anyone who practices an abomination or a lie, but only those whose names are written in the Lambʼs Book of Life.
The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation. He is my God, and I will praise Him, my fatherʼs God, and I will exalt Him.
Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!
Open the gates so a righteous nation may enter— one that remains faithful.
For better is one day in Your courts than a thousand elsewhere. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of the wicked.
But Jesus looked directly at them and said, “Then what is the meaning of that which is written: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone’?
Jesus said to them, “Have you never read in the Scriptures: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone. This is from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes’?
This Jesus is ‘the stone you builders rejected, which has become the cornerstone.’
As you come to Him, the living stone, rejected by men but chosen and precious in Godʼs sight,
and, “A stone of stumbling and a rock of offense.” They stumble because they disobey the word—and to this they were appointed.
Have you never read this Scripture: ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
This is from the Lord, and it is marvelous in our eyes’?”

notes.title: Hosanna: blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD

crossrefs.text: “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Peace in heaven and glory in the highest!”
The crowds that went ahead of Him and those that followed were shouting: “Hosanna to the Son of David!” “Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Hosanna in the highest!”
For I tell you that you will not see Me again until you say, ‘Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord.’”
They took palm branches and went out to meet Him, shouting: “Hosanna!” “Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Blessed is the King of Israel!”
For You, O LORD, light my lamp; my God lights up my darkness.
O LORD, You are my God! I will exalt You; I will praise Your name. For You have worked wonders— plans formed long ago— in perfect faithfulness.
Once again, Jesus spoke to the people and said, “I am the light of the world. Whoever follows Me will never walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
Look, your house is left to you desolate. And I tell you that you will not see Me again until you say, ‘Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord.’”
